newsitem.title: USA: Conn.'s Ritter mulls run for governor - report.
newsitem.headline: Conn.'s Ritter mulls run for governor - report.

text.p: House Speaker Thomas Ritter, a Democrat, is considering a run for governor in 1998, Hartford Courant reported Tuesday.
Ritter, 44, of Hartford, has formed an exploratory committee, and will decide on the race by October after spending the summer raising money, according to the report.
Ritter predicted to the Courant that he would be the "consensus candidate" for Democrats as they oppose Republican Gov. John Rowland.
Also considering campaigns for the Democrats are U.S. Rep. Barbara Kennelly and 1994 nominee William E. Curry, Jr., among others.
